title: Fiscal Responsibility And Budget Management FRBM Act 2003
definition: An enactment of the Parliament of India institutionalized to institutionalize financial discipline, reduce fiscal deficit, macro-economic stability, and mandate prudent management of public funds by the Central Government.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (fiscal targets, statutory definitions, escape clauses) and Mains GS Paper III (Indian Economy, budgetary trends, fiscal federalism, cooperative federalism, and macroeconomic stability).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Fiscal Responsibility And Budget Management FRBM Act 2003.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Components of Union Budget (Revenue and Capital accounts)
Role of Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
